text_block_list.text: I'm getting tired of stepping on other people's shadows.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The tide's about to change. …I can win now. I know it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph… That's right. I'll pass all those shadows, and…
